scripts.build: node tools/prepare_online_voice.mjs && node tools/generate_notices.mjs && tsc --noEmit && vite build
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis --config electron-builder.json
scripts.build:personal: node tools/prepare_online_voice.mjs && node tools/generate_notices.mjs && tsc --noEmit && vite build --mode personal
scripts.dist:personal: npm run build:personal && node tools/prepare_personal_release.mjs && electron-builder --win nsis --config private/personal-builder.json
